short: The decisive battle of the Wars of the Roses, where Henry Tudor defeated Richard III to claim the throne.
full:
On 22 August 1485, a rebel force led by Henry Tudor engaged the royal army of King Richard III near Market Bosworth in Leicestershire. Richard led a daring cavalry charge deep into the enemy ranks in an attempt to kill Henry and end the battle quickly.

The charge failed when key noble contingents either held back or betrayed Richard, intervening on Henry's behalf. Richard III was surrounded and killed, making him the last English king to die in battle. Henry was crowned king, establishing the Tudor dynasty and bringing long-term stability to England.
